literal: in the waking state / that which was seen, too / right there / dream too / indeed / seen / at the very time / is sweet
translation: What was seen in the waking state was sweet right then; the dream too is sweet at the very time it is seen.
modern: நனவில் காதலர் தந்த இன்பம் அப்பொழுது இனிமையாக இருந்தது; அதுபோலவே கனவும் அதைக் காணும் பொழுது இனிமையாகவே இருக்கிறது.
explanation: The speaker reflects on the nature of her experiences with her lover. She states that the joy she experienced in her waking state was sweet exactly when it happened. In the same way, the dream she has of him is sweet at the very moment she experiences it. The lengthened vowel in 'கண்டதூஉம்' (what was seen) adds a lingering emphasis to her memory of the waking experience, while avoiding complex joining rules by being treated as a single unit here. By equating the two, she validates the comfort she finds in her dreams.
